name: silassare/ozone
description: OZone is a framework to build RESTFul API and website.

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required to use the MySQL driver.
suggest.ext-sqlite3: Required to use the SQLite driver.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required to use the PostgreSQL driver.
suggest.ext-memcached: Required to use Memcached Cache driver.
suggest.ext-redis: Required to use Redis Cache driver.
suggest.ext-curl: Streams object storage uploads and downloads; without it they are sent part by part.
suggest.ext-intl: The plural rules of translations (one, few...) and the number filter; without it a text chooses its plural with =N, comparisons and other.
suggest.ext-swoole: Required to serve OZone from Swoole (OZONE\Core\Runtime\Bridges\SwooleBridge).
suggest.spiral/roadrunner-http: Required to serve OZone from RoadRunner (OZONE\Core\Runtime\Bridges\RoadRunnerBridge).
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required by the test kit's base test case and traits (OZONE\Core\Testing\IntegrationTestCase, OZONE\Core\Testing\Traits).
suggest.ext-imagick: An image driver: OZone uses the first of libvips, Imagick and GD the server has (oz.files OZ_IMAGE_DRIVER).
suggest.ext-ffi: With intervention/image-driver-vips and libvips, the fastest image driver.
suggest.intervention/image-driver-vips: The libvips image driver (with ext-ffi and libvips installed).
suggest.ext-exif: Reads a photo's orientation, so it is served upright.
